introduction: “Booked: First Day In” follows arrested individuals through America’s booking process, offering an extraordinary look at the most unusual, bizarre and often tense bookings. Every year in America, nearly 9 million people are arrested and booked into jail. Each episode follows the story of arrestees as they move through the system and recount what ultimately led to their time in jail. From both the arrestees’ and the officers’ points of view, viewers will be taken on a harrowing adventure as they watch the entire booking process.Production company: Lucky 8 TV, LLC
